name: com.mytoolz.localization
description: ScriptableObject-driven, CSV-backed translation. A LocalizationDatabaseSO parses a .csv TextAsset, LocalizationLanguageSO assets describe each language, LocalizationBindingSO binds a CSV key (picked from an always-up-to-date dropdown) to components, LocalizationText renders the current language, and a singleton LocalizationManager drives language selection through the EventBus (ChangeLanguageRequest).
